notes:
Account snapshot: SageBridge builds an ML-powered helpdesk assistant used by enterprise SaaS customers. Looking to replace current vector search + heuristics pipeline with a production RAG stack focused on fast top-5 relevant results for ticket deflection and first-contact resolution.

Key constraints / priorities:
- Tight latency SLO: p95 end-to-end (query -> top-5 reranked responses) target <300ms for 95% of queries; p99 goal <600ms. Must be consistent across US regions.
- Indexing scale: ~12M historical support docs (articles, transcripts, attachments) + continuous ingestion of ~25k new docs/week. Need efficient incremental embeddings and cold/hot storage tiering.
- Cost per live query target: <$0.01 (aspirational), finance constrained; evaluating batching + caching to control unit economics.
- Relevance quality goal: reranker to improve top-5 precision to >=85% (current baseline ~72% with FAISS + simple BM25).
- Security: SSO (SAML), org-level audit logs, KMS integration, and EU data residency for specific customers.
- Deployment: prefer Dedicated (VPC) for predictable throughput; open to Hosted API for burst/fallback.

POC summary (notes from sessions):
- 2026-02-28 demo (Fireflies ff_20260228_sagebridge_demo): ran 10k synthetic queries representative of ticket deflection traffic. Redwood dedicated config (poc-2xA100) showed median latency ~110ms, p95 ~280ms with 4k batch window and prefix KV cache enabled.
- Reranking experiment: used lightweight cross-encoder on a 350M model quantized; improved top-5 precision to 86% on held-out eval set of 1k tickets. Tradeoff: reranker adds ~90ms median per-query when run synchronously; team liked fallback policy where a fast sparse retrieval result is returned and reranker augments in parallel for candidates.
- Embeddings pipeline: currently using 1536-d embeddings; ingest pipeline needs resumable jobs and partial re-embed on doc updates. Asked about Redwood Optimize recommendations for quantization profiles and continuous batching thresholds.
